title: Loudspeaker box
summary: your driver's data sheet, sealed or vented
description: A cabinet for one loudspeaker driver from its data sheet: the volume from Thiele and Small's alignments, measured on the model, a flared port tuned by Helmholtz, and finger-jointed or rebated panels for the router or the saw.
process: CNC routing or table-saw joinery of MDF or birch plywood, veneered

difficulty.rationale: Coupled Thiele-Small physics, ranges by formula, a measured cavity gauge and two joint topologies.

standards: R. H. Small, Closed-Box Loudspeaker Systems, JAES 20 and 21 (1972-73): alpha, fc, Qtc, f3
R. H. Small, Vented-Box Loudspeaker Systems, JAES 21 (1973): a1, a2, a3 with QL
A. N. Thiele, Loudspeakers in Vented Boxes, JAES 19 (1971): QB3 alignment
Futtrup and Candy, Quasi-Alignment Families, Voice Coil, January 2025 (recursion, BL4Q and LR4Q targets)
Scan-Speak Technical Note 07 (2020): QB3 and closed-box values reproduced by this Jig
Levine and Schwinger 1948, Rayleigh: end corrections 0.613 r and 0.85 r
Salvatti, Devantier, Button, Maximizing Performance from Loudspeaker Ports, JAES 50 (2002): port air speed
materials: Round port tube with a flared mouth
